description:
Hello Everyone, 
 
 Our client Industries is looking for two Senior Java Developers. We need a backend and a UI developer. The candidates must complete a coding challenge and be able come to Birmingham for a f2f interview. The process: Consultant completes coding challenge, does one f2f interview, then there is an offer. 
 
 Backend Java Developer and UI Developer 
 Birmingham, AL 
 Years of experience: 5+ years 
 Length : Ongoing Contract 
 Job Description: 
 Any Visa 
 
 Overview: 
 
 Role: Senior Developer 
 
 Degree in computer science, software engineering or related discipline - preferred 
 6+ years in Java Application Development (Java/J2EE/EJB) 
 Proficient in SQL Database Development (also DB2) 
 Comprehensive SDLC experience (requirements, architecture, design, testing and deployment) 
 Understand and be able to explain common OO Design patterns. Knowledge of front controller pattern a strong +Web Service Development (XML/SOAP/REST) 
 Object Oriented Analysis & Design (OOAD) 
 Knowledge of Cobol / CICS a plus (Migrating legacy code to java and native stored procedures) 
 Excellent communication skills 
 
 The Job Description: 
 
 Develop applications using JAVA framework with Sencha (Ext & Sencha Touch) front end technologies. 
 Experience Mobile Application Development 
 Knowledge and solid experience with open source frameworks such as Jquery, requireJS, EXT. 
 Contributions to Open Source Projects 
 Experience working on Agile teams using Scrum 
 Advanced knowledge and experience with DB2 & WebSphere application server. 

 Degree in computer science, software engineering or related discipline - preferred 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
